title_lines: constituted for the work of publishing the Veda
board.editor: Asthāna Mahāvidvān H. P. Venkata Rao
members: Brahmaśrī G. Viṣṇumūrti Bhaṭṭa, scholar of literature (sāhitya) and grammar (vyākaraṇa), His Highness the Maharaja's Sanskrit Mahāpāṭhaśālā (college), Mysore.
Asthāna Vidvān Brahmaśrī H. Gaṅgādhara Śāstri, scholar of astronomy-astrology (jyotiṣa) and scholar of the Kannada language.
Brahmaśrī Śrīnivāsa Śāstri, ghanapāṭhi (reciter of the Ghana-recitation) of the Ṛgveda.
Brahmaśrī Hiṭṭavaḷḷi Biḷigiri Raṅgājoisa, scholar of the śrauta (Vedic ritual) tradition.{{fn: The supplied text reads ಶೌತವಿದ್ವಾನ್ ('śauta-vidvān'); ಶ್ರೌತ (śrauta) is meant.}}
Brahmaśrī Hiṭṭavaḷḷi Devara Bhaṭṭa, scholar of the Mīmāṃsā philosophy.
Brahmaśrī G. N. Chakravarti, M.A., Professor of Sanskrit, St. Philomena's College, Mysore.
Brahmaśrī Veṅkaṭaramaṇācār, M.A., B.T., scholar of literature (sāhitya).
Brahmaśrī S. Raṅganāthan, scholar of literature (sāhitya), the Palace Sarasvatī Bhaṇḍāra (library).
Brahmaśrī Puttūru Anantakṛṣṇa Māchār, scholar of literature (sāhitya), Government Oriental Research Institute, Mysore.
Brahmaśrī S. Sītārāma Śāstri, retired paṇḍita, Government Oriental Research Institute, Mysore.

abbreviations.title: Explanation of the abbreviations
abbreviations.intro: The printed abbreviation, the form used in this translation, and the work.
abbreviations.note: The printed list gives ಋ. ಸಂ. as 'ಋಗ್ವದ ಸಂಹಿತಾ' (sic). In the supplied text of the volume several of these abbreviations are misread (ಸಿ. for ನಿ. = Ni.; ಮಿ. / ಮ. / ಪು. ಸಂ. for ಋ. ಸಂ. = Ṛ. Saṃ.; ಇ. ಬ್ರಾ. for ಐ. ಬ್ರಾ. = Ai. Brā.); they have been corrected in this edition.
